scenes.say: A glowing ball a hundred and twelve metres tall, and F1 cars race right past it.
The Sphere opened in September twenty twenty-three, seven weeks before the first Vegas race.
Its outside has one point two million LED pucks. The largest screen in the world.
The track wraps around it in sector two and runs alongside after Turn nine.
During sessions F1 banned red, yellow and blue on it. Drivers could mistake them for flags.
Instead it showed pole position live, cards of all twenty drivers and the podium.
Flags and the safety car came up on the Sphere in sync with race control.
The deal now runs to twenty thirty, and on Saturday the Sphere hosts the first F1 afterparty.
Follow Saturday's race on the LapRadar live map.

title: The Sphere and F1: a 112-metre ball of light beside the Las Vegas track
